Hi Sarah —

Putting a quick pulse check on the MAP ahead of our Thursday dry-run. Attached: MAP_v3.xlsx (action tracker) and Runbook_v2.pdf (operational steps). Key asks in this note:

1) Confirm the launch date still stands as 2026-07-18 09:00 PT. If MedSync needs a shift, flag now — we have one reserve week.
2) Confirm owners listed in the attached MAP tab “Cutover Owners” (infra / data / QA / comms). If there are internal owner changes at MedSync, please reply with names and emails.
3) We’ll run a full dry run on 2026-07-15 08:00 PT — please confirm who will join for data validation and failover exercises.
4) Any additional compliance artifacts we should have on-hand during cutover (SOC report, retention policy excerpts)? If yes, please attach.

Runbook highlights included in the PDF: pre-cutover checklist, traffic shift steps, KV cache warmup, rollback trigger conditions (3 consecutive SLA misses or data validation failure), and an immediate fallback to read-only mode.

Action items I’ll own from Redwood: coordinating the dry-run orchestration, finalizing fallback automation scripts, and ensuring SLO dashboards are published to the shared Drive link.

Please review and ack by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the rehearsal attendee list.

Thanks,
Karthik

Subject: Re: MAP final pulse: cutover roles, runbook, and rollback confirmation — final checklist and go/no-go criteria

Sarah / team —

Finalize notes after the week’s syncs and the attachments we received: I’ve pulled everything into the MAP_v3.xlsx and updated the cutover checklist. Quick summary and final go/no-go criteria below — please read and ack: 

Pre-cutover must-have (all required before 07/18 09:00 PT):
- Signed SOW in DocuSign (Procurement) — link shared in-thread.
- TTL/KV configuration published in this thread (Ben) and confirmed by MedSync security (Sarah).
- Rehearsal completed and pass criteria met (Laura) — data validation scripts return zero critical errors.
- Monitoring dashboards created and shared to the mutual Drive link (Karthik).

Go/no-go decision matrix (simple):
- GREEN: All 4 must-haves complete 24 hours before launch.
- YELLOW: 1 non-critical item outstanding with agreed mitigation and 12-hour rollback window.
- RED: Any failure in rehearsal or unresolved security item => postpone launch.

Owners & immediate actions (owner — action — due):
- Ben Carter — attach TTL/KV config to this thread and to Runbook_v2.pdf (embedded) — DUE 2026-07-10 17:00 PT.
- Laura Bennett — upload final runbook to Drive and run verification script in the 07/15 rehearsal — DUE 2026-07-11 09:00 PT.
- Monica Patel — prepare the rollback communication template for customers and perform the rollback dry-run — DUE 2026-07-14 12:00 PT.
- Sarah Lee (MedSync) — confirm Priya Sharma as QA sign-off and confirm procurement timeline for SOW — DUE 2026-07-10 EOD.

Meeting: Dry-run 2026-07-15 08:00 PT (90 minutes) — calendar invite will go out from Karthik. Please ensure attendees listed in the MAP are present for the full slot.

If everyone is aligned, reply with a short "ACK" and we’ll mark the MAP milestone as locked. If you need changes, clearly state which item and proposed resolution window.

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth rehearsal and an on-time cutover.

Karthik
